summary: Willamette NF hill north of Oakridge, OR: tree lookout from the 1920s, then towers; last 28-ft tower removed or destroyed 1968; trail #3468 leads toward the point, view blocked by trees.

facts.status_note: Last 28-foot tower removed (register) or destroyed (firelookout.com) in 1968; no source describes remains; the Forest Service trail page says trees now obscure the view

staffing.status: Lookout staff in 1925 and 1927; AWS cabin station 1942-1943; observer in 1957

access.note: Public Forest Service trail #3468 reaches the top by a side trail, but the page lists a seasonal closure to all users (January 1 to July 31) and fire damage from the Bedrock Fire

visit.trail_note: Trail climbs 1.8 miles from Logan Creek to the ridge, then a side trail goes up to the top; the page warns the trail may be impassable in some sections

corrections.why: 27.4 m is 90 feet, the height of the first 1924 tree. The last tower on the site was 28 feet, about 8.5 m, built in 1959.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the first tree lookout to 1924. Rex's page says c.1920. The story gives 1924 from the register and notes the other date.
The three sources give different heights, cab sizes and years for the towers built between 1928 and 1939. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick one sequence.
The register says the last tower was removed in 1968. firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year. Both give 1968, so only the manner of loss differs.
firelookout.com gives about 15 miles north of Oakridge; the NGS station description reproduced on Rex's page gives 14 miles. The story says 14 to 15 miles.

notes_for_editor: The access level 'restricted' is a judgment from the Forest Service trail page, which lists a seasonal closure to all users (January 1 to July 31) and a Bedrock Fire impact. The trail page was last updated August 12, 2025. The height correction from 27.4 m to 8.5 m is proposed; the record's 27.4 m matches only the 1924 tree. Distance from Oakridge is 14 to 15 miles across the sources (see resolved_conflicts).
